name: Whitepaper memo in LaTeX
prompt: Typeset the memo text in {root}/memo-source.md as a LaTeX memo and build the PDF at {target}. Keep every sentence of the source word for word. Change layout only, never the prose or the claims.
claim: The memo PDF holds Joe's prose unchanged, laid out cleanly, in the deck rewrite folder.
rubric: Every sentence of the source text appears unchanged in the PDF.
No claim was added, removed or softened.
No equation, figure or table runs off the page or overlaps other text.
The PDF sits in the deck rewrite folder.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
